I sent the agenda to partnerships@greenwave-ventures.com, the address in the description of your 15:00 Introductory meeting on May 15.

The email's subject is "Agenda for Introductory Meeting" and its body reads "introductions, goals, next steps".

My first two attempts were blocked by a security policy. It only accepts that exact subject and that exact body text. So the email is plainer than I wanted, with no greeting, numbered list or meeting details.
